timing: before loss/model implementation, synthetic tests, GPU smoke, formal training, or new validation access
reason: freeze exact optimizer/loader pairing, vectorized hard-bin algorithm, calibration aggregation, bootstrap and checkpoint contracts

loss_exact_contract.logits: cast raw logits to float32, then sigmoid
loss_exact_contract.assignment: torch.bucketize(probability.detach(),boundaries[1:],right=false); exact boundary goes to lower bin
loss_exact_contract.vectorization: flatten BxN probabilities/labels; add batch_index*20 to bin indices; bincount for counts and scatter_add for sum_probability/sum_target
loss_exact_contract.gradient: bin index detached; sum_probability uses attached probability; no detach elsewhere
loss_exact_contract.occupied: counts>0; per-case ACE nan/boolean mean only occupied bins
loss_exact_contract.empty_target: if target foreground sum is zero, set that case ACE to zero but retain it in batch mean
loss_exact_contract.batch_reduction: equal mean over eight case ACE values

optimizer_loader_contract.checkpoint: load KD200 model state only; no historical optimizer state
optimizer_loader_contract.determinism: cudnn benchmark=false,deterministic=true; reset Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG20260860 after model/loss/optimizer/loader construction

paired_reference.required: initial state,first batch case/raw/aug image/raw/aug label,and all201-232 case-order/CUDA RNG before/after hashes exactly equal

calibration_evaluation.input: sigmoid raw foreground logit,20 hard bins,right=false,no threshold
calibration_evaluation.macro_ace: occupied-bin mean absolute gap per case,then108-case equal mean
calibration_evaluation.macro_ece: count-weighted absolute gap per case,then108-case equal mean
calibration_evaluation.macro_mce: maximum occupied-bin absolute gap per case,then108-case equal mean
calibration_evaluation.official_micro_ace: per-bin mean_probability nanmean across cases; mean_target=sum_target/sum_count across cases; occupied-bin mean absolute gap
calibration_evaluation.pooled_voxel_ace: per-bin sum_probability/sum_count and sum_target/sum_count; occupied-bin mean absolute gap; supplemental only
calibration_evaluation.selection: none of these metrics may choose checkpoint; KAS/hACE checkpoint selection remains Scan Dice only

paired_bootstrap.additional_segmentation_safety: paired Scan and Subject CI lower bounds must be >=-0.003 versus both same-epoch control and KD200

checkpoint_contract.payload: deploy model_state_dict plus loss/pairing/data/optimizer metadata; no auxiliary trainable state
checkpoint_contract.reload: all four strict reload and exact logits; deployment unchanged

source_boundaries: official formula averages all M bins but code nanmeans occupied bins; project follows code
official foreground+background softmax is not strictly equivalent to single foreground sigmoid at exact bin boundaries; project freezes official one-channel behavior
source WT Dice declines0.0022 while WT macro ACE improves; calibration alone cannot authorize test
